entries.title: Matthew 25:1
segments: ¶"Then the kingdom of heaven shall be likened to ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

entries.title: Matthew 25:2
segments: "Now five of them were wise, and five [were] foolish.

entries.title: Matthew 25:3
segments: "Those who [were] foolish took their lamps and took no oil with them,

entries.title: Matthew 25:4
segments: "but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

entries.title: Matthew 25:5
segments: "But while the bridegroom was delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

entries.title: Matthew 25:6
segments: "And at midnight a cry was [heard]: 'Behold, the bridegroom is coming; go out to meet him!'

entries.title: Matthew 25:7
segments: "Then all those virgins arose and trimmed their lamps.

entries.title: Matthew 25:8
segments: "And the foolish said to the wise, 'Give us [some] of your oil, for our lamps are going out.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:9
segments: "But the wise answered, saying, '[No], lest there should not be enough for us and you; but go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:10
segments: "And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding; and the door was shut.

entries.title: Matthew 25:11
segments: "Afterward the other virgins came also, saying, 'Lord, Lord, open to us!'

entries.title: Matthew 25:12
segments: "But he answered and said, 'Assuredly, I say to you, I do not know you.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:13
segments: "Watch therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

entries.title: Matthew 25:14
segments: ¶"For [the kingdom of heaven is] like a man traveling to a far country, [who] called his own servants and delivered his goods to them.

entries.title: Matthew 25:15
segments: "And to one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one, to each according to his own ability; and immediately he went on a journey.

entries.title: Matthew 25:16
segments: "Then he who had received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

entries.title: Matthew 25:17
segments: "And likewise he who [had received] two gained two more also.

entries.title: Matthew 25:18
segments: "But he who had received one went and dug in the ground, and hid his lord's money.

entries.title: Matthew 25:19
segments: "After a long time the lord of those servants came and settled accounts with them.

entries.title: Matthew 25:20
segments: "So he who had received five talents came and brought five other talents, saying, 'Lord, you delivered to me five talents; look, I have gained five more talents besides them.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:21
segments: "His lord said to him, 'Well [done], good and faithful servant; you were faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:22
segments: "He also who had received two talents came and said, 'Lord, you delivered to me two talents; look, I have gained two more talents besides them.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:23
segments: "His lord said to him, 'Well [done], good and faithful servant; you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:24
segments: "Then he who had received the one talent came and said, 'Lord, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you have not sown, and gathering where you have not scattered seed.

entries.title: Matthew 25:25
segments: 'And I was afraid, and went and hid your talent in the ground. Look, [there] you have [what is] yours.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:26
segments: "But his lord answered and said to him, 'You wicked and lazy servant, you knew that I reap where I have not sown, and gather where I have not scattered seed.

entries.title: Matthew 25:27
segments: 'So you ought to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I would have received back my own with interest.

entries.title: Matthew 25:28
segments: 'Therefore take the talent from him, and give [it] to him who has ten talents.

entries.title: Matthew 25:29
segments: 'For to everyone who has, more will be given, and he will have abundance; but from him who does not have, even what he has will be taken away.

entries.title: Matthew 25:30
segments: 'And cast the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:31
segments: ¶"When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the holy angels with Him, then He will sit on the throne of His glory.

entries.title: Matthew 25:32
segments: "All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate them one from another, as a shepherd divides [his] sheep from the goats.

entries.title: Matthew 25:33
segments: "And He will set the sheep on His right hand, but the goats on the left.

entries.title: Matthew 25:34
segments: "Then the King will say to those on His right hand, 'Come, you blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

entries.title: Matthew 25:35
segments: 'for I was hungry and you gave Me food; I was thirsty and you gave Me drink; I was a stranger and you took Me in;

entries.title: Matthew 25:36
segments: 'I [was] naked and you clothed Me; I was sick and you visited Me; I was in prison and you came to Me.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:37
segments: "Then the righteous will answer Him, saying, 'Lord, when did we see You hungry and feed [You], or thirsty and give [You] drink?

entries.title: Matthew 25:38
segments: 'When did we see You a stranger and take [You] in, or naked and clothe [You]?

entries.title: Matthew 25:39
segments: 'Or when did we see You sick, or in prison, and come to You?'

entries.title: Matthew 25:40
segments: "And the King will answer and say to them, 'Assuredly, I say to you, inasmuch as you did [it] to one of the least of these My brethren, you did [it] to Me.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:41
segments: "Then He will also say to those on the left hand, 'Depart from Me, you cursed, into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels:

entries.title: Matthew 25:42
segments: 'for I was hungry and you gave Me no food; I was thirsty and you gave Me no drink;

entries.title: Matthew 25:43
segments: 'I was a stranger and you did not take Me in, naked and you did not clothe Me, sick and in prison and you did not visit Me.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:44
segments: "Then they also will answer Him, saying, 'Lord, when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not minister to You?'

entries.title: Matthew 25:45
segments: "Then He will answer them, saying, 'Assuredly, I say to you, inasmuch as you did not do [it] to one of the least of these, you did not do [it] to Me.'

entries.title: Matthew 25:46
segments: "And these will go away into everlasting punishment, but the righteous into eternal life."
